## Page 6

2025 
Year in 
Review 
Key highlights from 
fiscal year 2025 CEO's Strategic Commentary 
1Strategic Land Reclassification 
Executive Committee approved reclassification of select land holdings (THB 976 MB cost) into 
Investment Properties. Independent appraisal confirmed fair value of THB 1,740 MB – a gain of 
THB 657 MB that restored the Group to net profit for the first time in 3 years. 
2Q4 Revenue Recovery 
Q4 2025 revenues surged 60.5% quarter-on-quarter to THB 378.5 MB, driven by a 76.3% 
increase in property sales. Revenue from services and hospitality also grew across all 
sub-segments. 
3Flagship Sipraya Project – Montra Wellness & Residences 
The Montra Chaopraya – Charoenkrung (Sipraya) Project (THB 2,200 MB, 292 units) – CMC's 
landmark mixed-use development at the Charoen Krung–Si Phraya intersection with panoramic 
Chao Phraya River views – positions the Group as a regional leader in Preventive Medicine, 
Longevity & Anti-Aging. Targeted completion Q4 2030. 
4Strong Financial Discipline & Early Debenture Redemption 
The Group generated positive consolidated operating cash flow of THB +211.9 MB in FY2025, 
enabling the early redemption of the CMC257A debenture on 26 February 2026 – ahead of the 
original April 2026 maturity – demonstrating resilient cash generation and proactive liability 
management.

Flagship Project Spotlight – Montra Sipraya Project 
Largest project in portfolio by value  |  Status as at December 2025 
CMC Group – Chaoprayamahanakorn Public Company Limited  |  Year-End 2025  |  Confidential 
Montra Chaopraya – Charoenkrung 
Wellness & Residences 
Project Type Two Buildings – 28F Tower & 6F Low-Rise with 2 Basements 
Gross Floor Area 35,056 sq.m. 
Saleable Area 17,483 sq.m. 
Total Units 321 Units 
Project Value THB 2,200 Million 
Completion Q4 2030 
The Sipraya Project is the flagship development by CMC Group PLC, strategically situated at the prominent intersection of Charoen Krung Road and Si Phraya Road — 
commanding an unobstructed panoramic view of the Chao Phraya River. Comprising a 28-storey tower and a 6-storey low-rise building, the project seamlessly integrates 
premium residences, commercial spaces, and a boutique wellness hotel within a single iconic address. 
Designed to position CMC Group as a leading force in Preventive Medicine, Longevity, and Anti-Ageing across Asia, the Sipraya Project embodies the Company’s holistic 
healthcare vision — delivering an integrated continuum of services from preventive wellness to comprehensive medical care.
